thread:
Carmen S: quick heads-up — datadog index shows a snippet of KMS ciphertext from a staging partner payload landed in logs this morning. low volume but reproducible. not yet public :eyes:
David (oncall): any PII or plaintext leaked or just ciphertext?
Carmen S: just ciphertext/KMS blob, looks like base64ed ciphertext + metadata. found in raw delivery logs for partner-ingest-queue. no plaintext so far.
Alice L: pinging infra to confirm: was there any recent change to log redaction or forwarder?
Ben I: infra here — we rolled out a kafka-to-dd-forwarder change at 03:12UTC to add headers. could have allowed raw payload passthrough for a short window. investigating.
secalert-bot: Alert created: sec/4978654321 - potential-ciphertext-exposure in partner-ingest-queue logs. Severity: low->medium.
Carmen S: tagging vault/transit owners: we need to assess blast radius. which KMS/transit key does partner use for wrapping?
Ben I: partner uses gcp-kms key ring `projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap` for wrapping before pushing to our queue.
David (oncall): ok action list propose: 1) pause log forwarding for that queue, 2) scope audit to timeframe, 3) revoke any ephemeral unwrap grants, 4) rotate/rewrap values if needed. owners?
Alice L: I'll pause forwarding now and confirm TTL. doing `kubectl -n logging scale deploy/dd-forwarder --replicas=0`
Ben I: noted. pausing. also adding a filter to drop raw body at the forwarder side.
Carmen S: David please take lead on grant revocation. Ben/Alice handle forwarder patch and log purge. I'll scope and export matching ciphertexts for triage.
David (oncall): on it — checking IAM bindings. running `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ...` to find who had CryptoKeyVersions/cryptoKeyAccess. will revoke any non-service principals.
David (oncall): found a short-lived grant to `partner-transformer-sa@partner-xyz.iam.gserviceaccount.com` created 2026-03-17T03:11Z — matches deploy window. revoking now.
Carmen S: good catch. can we confirm if that SA had unwrap rights across other keys?
David (oncall): limited to that key ring. revoke complete. added annotation in incident ticket.
infra-bot: deploy pause detected and annotated on ticket #4978654321 by Alice L.
Ben I: forwarder filter pushed, dropping body fields. patch landed to staging, will prod rollout after validation.
Carmen S: next: do we need to rewrap any Vault transit ciphertexts stored in our KV? We only store partner-encrypted blobs, but there may be re-encryption steps.
Alice L: vault audit logs show reads but no decrypts from our transit path. looks like we never attempted to unwrap partner blob server-side.
Carmen S: that reduces risk. still want to rotate partner KMS key to be safe and ask partner to rotate on their side.
David (oncall): propose we rotate the GCP key (create new primary version) and update partner with new encryption endpoint. I'll coordinate with partner ops. ETA 4h?
Ben I: FYI we should also run log-scrub job to remove the ciphertext lines from datadog raw logs before retention kicks in. I can run a backfill to replace with `<redacted-ciphertext>` for matching entries.
Carmen S: Ben please do that and attach scrub report to the ticket. Alice, after forwarder patch and scrub, unpause forwarding.
Alice L: will validate scrub on staging first. planning to unpause at +2h after scrub completes.
Carmen S: checklist for postmortem: - timeline, - root cause (missing redaction during forwarder deploy), - scope of exposed ciphertexts, - key rotation confirmation (partner & us), - RBAC change to disallow ephemeral grants in deploy pipeline, - add audit alert to detect raw KMS blob patterns.
David (oncall): I'll own RBAC enforcement: adding terraform rule in `infra-iam` to block granting CryptoKey 'cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get' to external SAs without review.
Ben I: I'll add datadog pipeline rule to flag base64-looking ciphertext patterns and add an internal webhook to notify sec-team.
Carmen S: thanks. small follow-ups: 1) confirm that no plaintext was recovered (Alice/David), 2) notify partner with what we rotated and ask for their rotation plan (David), 3) draft customer-safe blurb if partner asks.
Alice L: plaintext check done — no decrypts recorded and no suspicious access logs.
David (oncall): partner notified, they acknowledged and will rotate their key and check their side. i gave them the new key version ID and rotation window.
Carmen S: ok close loop after scrub and rotation. assign owners in ticket: david->rbac+partner coord, ben->scrub+alert, alice->forwarder rollout, carmen->postmortem and incident write-up.
David (oncall): copying notes to incident doc. will follow up with PR for the TF rule.
Ben I: scrub complete on prod slice, replaced 124 lines, report attached.
Alice L: prod forwarder unpaused at 2:45UTC, monitoring — no regressions so far.
Carmen S: thanks team. lowering severity to low after rotation + scrub. will start postmortem draft now. :thumbsup:
secalert-bot: Incident 4978654321 transitioned to status: monitoring.
Carmen S: closing thread here, continue updates in ticket.
